verdict.rationale: First-party docs state there is one API key with official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java, plus a C# package and a CLI listed in the reference. A Python code sample shows `client.parsing.parse(...)`, and the GitHub repo directs users to the current official packages (`llama-cloud` on pip, `@llamaindex/llama-cloud` on npm), with TypeScript/Node.js examples also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality; clear feature parity across languages (the Extract page lists only a Python SDK); and stability, since users are being told to migrate from older packages.
